'''Jeff Alexander''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Bravo 5 from Boca Raton, Fl. His slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
